question: whether a wing keeps its target through a save

struct_fields.name: target_id_type
struct_fields.comment: The type half of the persistent id of the ship this one last shot at; with +0xBC, the remembered target CSubUnit::PickTarget keeps from hour to hour. Cleared by CCombatant::AddUnit and for a ship that cannot shoot. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-seabattle.md, section 4. **Not saved**: a save of a battle in the air, 2026-11-10, holds no such key, so a loaded game picks again where a running one keeps it (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 10).
struct_fields.evidence: A wing block of Ireland1936 February, written by the game while the battle ran, holds no target key; the original then spent the extra draws only after a reload would.
